verdict.rationale: Deel is a payroll platform, so configuring multiple pay schedules is an applicable axis. However, the evidence only makes general claims about running compliant payroll across 150+ countries. Nothing documents setting up weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, or monthly pay schedules, or assigning different schedules to different teams.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set up multiple pay schedules (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) across different teams
